d: China’s Shenzhou-24 spacecraft successfully docked with the Tiangong space station on November 25, 2026, carrying 40-year-old former Pakistan Air Force pilot Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, making him the first Pakistani astronaut in space and the first foreign national to visit China’s orbital station. Launched aboard a Long March-2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center at 8:18 a.m. local time alongside mission commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi, the spacecraft completed an automated three-and-a-half-hour rendezvous with the Tianhe core module.
